name: tctl
description: Repo-local Codex plugin scaffold for the tctl MCP integration.

interface.shortDescription: Request/response tctl tools for analysis and side-effecting execution.
interface.longDescription: CLI-wrapper MCP plugin for tctl. It exposes existing request/response commands only, separates read and mutating tools, keeps fund-arb as a standalone composite mutating tool, and leaves watch/streaming deferred in v1.
